title: Chess Fundamentals #1: Undefended Pieces
summary: First video in John Bartholomew's Chess Fundamentals series, focused on spotting undefended pieces. He teaches habits for scanning your own and your opponent's position to avoid hanging pieces.
why: HN chess improvers recommend Bartholomew's beginner playlist as a clear, approachable path to getting better.
